$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (gateway-federated-api-discovery Tasks 2-3, REQ-FEDG-002). Dormant discovery of the services on a Kong gateway, read daily into external_api through the Kong Admin API 3.x. No code: the synchronization engine pages (Kong answers a `next` link), maps and upserts, and an API Kong no longer returns is marked ended, never deleted.

objects.name: Kong gateway (API discovery)
objects.description: The Admin API of one Kong gateway, 3.x (https://docs.konghq.com/gateway/api/admin-oss/latest/). List call: GET /services, at most `size` per call, the next page in the `next` link. Auth: an admin token in the `Kong-Admin-Token` header, held by the credential broker. Set the location to the Admin API URL of your gateway (for example https://kong-admin.example.org:8444), add the credential, then enable the source and the job.

objects.name: Kong service to external_api
objects.description: One Kong service as an external_api. The base URL is the upstream Kong proxies to (protocol, host, port and path of the service). Kong attaches no OpenAPI document to a service, so `openApiDocument` is left empty.

mapping.name: {{ name|default(id) }}
mapping.baseUrl: {{ protocol|default('http') }}://{{ host }}{{ port|default('') is empty ? '' : ':' ~ port }}{{ path|default('') }}

objects.name: Kong services to the API inventory
objects.description: Reads every service of the Kong gateway into the API inventory. A service Kong stops returning is marked no longer seen (`markEnded`), never deleted.

objects.name: Kong API discovery, daily
objects.description: Runs the Kong discovery synchronization once a day. Off until the source has a location and a credential.
